description: This Java source file defines a custom layout class `ExpandingLayout` that extends `RelativeLayout` to create an expandable and collapsible UI component with fade effects by controlling height measurements during state changes.

classes.name: ExpandingLayout
classes.description: A custom RelativeLayout that supports expanding and collapsing with animated height changes, designed to enable fade effects during these transitions.

methods.name: ExpandingLayout
methods.description: Constructors for the ExpandingLayout class, initializing the layout with context and optional attribute set and style.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Overrides the measurement process to set the height to the stored expanded height when in expanded state.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Overrides to capture the height when the size changes and notify a listener.

methods.name: getExpandedHeight
methods.description: Returns the current expanded height of the layout.

methods.name: setExpandedHeight
methods.description: Sets the height to which the layout should expand.

methods.name: setSizeChangedListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to be notified when the size of the layout changes.
